packMeta.name: BrewDesk (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey cafe and barista operations desk: live order pad, espresso ticket queue, menu board, beans and milk par stock, shift roster and daily closeout. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
